title: Chameleon reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='10' y='82' width='80' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='10' y='82' width='80' height='3' rx='2' fill='#A8723C'/>
  <!-- chameleon body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='63' rx='28' ry='18' fill='#3CB043'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='60' rx='26' ry='15' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <!-- back ridge -->
  <path d='M28 55 Q32 46 38 52 Q42 43 48 50 Q54 42 58 50 Q64 44 68 52' fill='none' stroke='#2E8B2E' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- curled tail -->
  <path d='M22 64 Q10 64 10 54 Q10 46 18 46 Q24 46 24 52' fill='none' stroke='#3CB043' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M22 64 Q12 64 12 55 Q12 48 18 48' fill='none' stroke='#4CD964' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front arm holding book -->
  <path d='M58 68 Q64 74 68 70' fill='none' stroke='#3CB043' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='70' r='3.5' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='46' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#3CB043'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='44' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#4CD964'/>
  <!-- casque/crest -->
  <path d='M56 38 Q60 28 68 34 Q74 36 76 42' fill='#2E8B2E'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='7' fill='#F5F5DC'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='42' r='4' fill='#1A1A50'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M72 50 Q76 53 79 50' fill='none' stroke='#2E8B2E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 78 72)'>
    <rect x='68' y='62' width='24' height='16' rx='2' fill='#D32F2F'/>
    <rect x='69' y='63' width='22' height='13' rx='1.5' fill='#FFCDD2'/>
    <line x1='80' y1='63' x2='80' y2='76' stroke='#D32F2F' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='72' y1='67' x2='78' y2='67' stroke='#D32F2F' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='72' y1='70' x2='78' y2='70' stroke='#D32F2F' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='82' y1='67' x2='88' y2='67' stroke='#D32F2F' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='82' y1='70' x2='88' y2='70' stroke='#D32F2F' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='58' r='3' fill='#2E8B2E'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#2E8B2E'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='66' r='2' fill='#2E8B2E'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#2E8B2E'/>
  <!-- hind foot gripping branch -->
  <path d='M38 78 Q36 82 40 82 M44 78 Q42 82 46 82' fill='none' stroke='#3CB043' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
